pages.title: What lives here
pages.text: $(li)$(l:plains/poludnytsia)Poludnytsia$(/l): a flower that looks like the sun;$(li)$(l:plains/polovyk)Polovyk$(/l): master of the Plains;$(li)$(l:plains/vovkulaka)Vovkulaky$(/l): black wolves the size of horses;$(li)$(l:plains/chort)Chort$(/l): a girl in white wandering the field.$(br2)Ordinary creatures appear too: sheep, cows, pigs, and the usual enemies at night.

pages.title: Rings of Poludnytsia
pages.text: Poludnytsia grow in rings around the centre of the biome, each ring narrower than the last. Follow the rings inward and they lead to the $(l:plains/polovyk)Polovyk$(/l).$(br2)The Plains are smaller than the Forest, but there is room to roam. They only appear in new, not yet visited parts of the world.
